newsitem.title: USA: AT&T sets Dec 13 record date for NCR spinoff.
newsitem.headline: AT&T sets Dec 13 record date for NCR spinoff.

text.p: AT&T Corp said Wednesday that it had set December 13 as the record date for the spinoff of NCR Corp.

The company said that it declared a special stock dividend, the distribution of shares of common stock in NCR, to AT&T shareowners of record on December 13. It said this would finalize the spinoff of NCR and the strategic restructuring of AT&T announced on September 20, 1995.

AT&T said the NCR shares will be distributed on the basis of 0.0625 of a share of NCR for each AT&T share owned, a one for 16 distribution ratio that will result in AT&T shareowners receiving about 101 million shares of NCR common stock.
